r: You are an unusual color. Why are you blue?

blue_cat_blue.m: It was Bonicksa, that wicked witch, she did this to me.

blue_cat_blue2.m: Well, you see those rats over there? The ones in the cage?

blue_cat_blue3.m: You see, those things are delicious.
r: Um, OK, but what does that have to do with Bonicksa?

blue_cat_blue4.m: Oh, you don't know? Those are Bonicksa's rats and she doesn't appreciate anything happening to them.

blue_cat_blue5.m: She caught me killing her favorite one day. I got away that day, but she was relentless in her attempts to hurt me.

blue_cat_blue6.m: Well, after many months of trying, she was lucky one day and was able to capture me.

blue_cat_blue7.m: She used her black magic to turn my beautiful white fur to this awful color I am now.
r: Oh, I am so sorry for you.

blue_cat_talk.m: Talk? Well, let me ask you this: Why don't my friends up there talk?
r: Well, I guess you've got me there.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
